about: Golden vectors for the per-key proof of 21C keys (decided 2026-09-26). Talia's own extra set, made ONCE with the v2 code of 21st Capital's key tooling (leaf, tree, manifest, key_proof, and every expectation checked by its check_key_proof), test keys and placeholder xpub strings; the shared set is key-proof-vectors.json. NEVER regenerate: a change of encoding must fail these, not move them. Every key here is a test key; no xpub is real.
